resources.string:
Lets SimSwitch change your mobile data SIM by opening the SIM manager and tapping it for you.

This is the only mechanism that keeps working away from Wi-Fi. The privileged shortcut (Shizuku) is started by adb, and Android kills it the moment you leave the Wi-Fi network you enabled Wireless debugging on — which is exactly when a better network matters.

SimSwitch only ever reads the SIM manager screen. It cannot see any other app.
